sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "account_groups" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "banks" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "number" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "phone_number" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "profile_image" TEXT NULL, "telegram_id" TEXT NULL, "instagram_id" TEXT NULL, "birthday" INTEGER NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "teams" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "events" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "team_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entrance_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "snacks_fee" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "is_closed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_closed" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "detailed_accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_i_d" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id), "event_i_d" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES events (id), "bank_i_d" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES banks (id), UNIQUE ("event_i_d", "user_i_d", "bank_i_d"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_orders" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "event_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "is_delivered" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_delivered" IN (0, 1)), "menu_items" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "funds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_balance" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "event_registrations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "event_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "user_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "snacks_assignment_user_i_d" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "snacks_assignment_fund_i_d" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES funds (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "snacks_fee_assignment_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unassign', "gross_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "discount_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "net_amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "was_absent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("was_absent" IN (0, 1)), "description" TEXT NULL, "registered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), UNIQUE ("event_i_d", "user_i_d"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fund_allocations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fund_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES funds (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "share_percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), UNIQUE ("event_i_d", "fund_i_d"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fund_balances" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fund_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES funds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "series" TEXT NOT NULL, "debit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "memo" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "general_accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "complete_code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "account_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account_groups (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_headers" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entry_number" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "entry_date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'normal', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subsidiary_accounts" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "account_group_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES account_groups (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "general_account_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES general_accounts (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "complete_code" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system_default" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_system_default" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "journal_lines" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "header_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES journal_headers (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE, "subsidiary_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES subsidiary_accounts (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "first_detailed_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES detailed_accounts (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "second_detailed_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES detailed_accounts (id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT, "debit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "credit" INTEGER NOT NULL, "series" TEXT NOT NULL, "memo" TEXT NULL, "notice_memo" TEXT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), CHECK (debit >= 0), CHECK (credit >= 0), CHECK (debit = 0 OR credit = 0));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "member_allocations" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "event_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES events (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "share_percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), UNIQUE ("event_i_d", "user_i_d"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "menu_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_funds" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "fund_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES funds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "team_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "share_percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "team_members" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "user_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "team_i_d" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "share_percentage" REAL NOT NULL, "create_at" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (strftime('%s', CURRENT_DATE)));
